3705910a532f.en: A "fleshy" focused evolution to the Finaies interface! Its capabilities outgrew Finaies in raw power and eventually led Buhraies to force themselves to become powerful enough to reshape the land and other creatures to their liking.
3705910a532f.t: 菲奈斯界面以“肉体”为重点的进化！它的纯粹力量超越了菲奈斯，最终导致布莱斯逼迫自己变得足够强大，能够随心所欲地重塑土地和其他生物。

5fed524a49f2.en: That is, unless you’re doing a freeform! You will not have the pain of carving your palm, but it might cost your soul or the souls of people around you. Despite Buhraies having a natural inkling for controlling free-forming, including being able to shape the very land to their will, that same power was likely their demise.
5fed524a49f2.t: 除非你在进行自由施法！你不必忍受在手掌上刻字的痛苦，但它可能会耗费你的灵魂，或者你周围人的灵魂。尽管布莱斯天生就擅长控制自由施法，甚至能按自己的意愿塑造土地本身，但正是这种力量很可能导致了他们的灭亡。

60c23bd68b7a.en: You must carve the logograms into the skin of one of your palms, then clench your fingers to start the interface while keeping the palm visible.
60c23bd68b7a.t: 你必须把语标文字刻在一只手掌的皮肤上，然后握紧手指来启动界面，同时让手掌保持可见。

c407da5e9c64.en: Despite lacking the distinct capillary branching appearances of the Darfaries interface, all Buhraies are better at controlling flight and speed than anybody else! They can even hover at will!
c407da5e9c64.t: 尽管没有达尔法里斯界面那种独特的毛细血管分支外观，所有布莱斯在控制飞行和速度方面都比任何人都强！他们甚至可以随意悬停！

e3cc5a5f7427.en: All Buhraies show the markings of controlled flight and built-in spell-casting mechanisms using specialized nerves attuned to soul energy that appear as veins, at least to the untrained eye, throughout the body. These reddened nerves run up and down their body.
e3cc5a5f7427.t: 所有布莱斯身上都带有可控飞行和内置施法机制的印记，这些机制使用与灵魂能量同调的特化神经，至少在外行看来，它们就像遍布全身的血管。这些发红的神经在他们全身上下延伸。
